files.round24_live_membership_evidence_excerpt: Hand-trimmed excerpt of the human-readable output of scripts/report_interchange_evidence.py, run by the repository owner against a deployment's populated match_interchange_evidence_observations table and supplied on PR #206. Covers 4 of the 7 real matches in the original supplied report (CD_M20260142401, CD_M20260142406, CD_M20260142408, CD_M20260142409), with '...' marking elided lines.

capture.supplied_by: repository owner, for review during PR #206 (Issue #204 production promotion)
capture.original_report_scope: 7 real Round 24 matches: CD_M20260142401, CD_M20260142403, CD_M20260142404, CD_M20260142405, CD_M20260142406, CD_M20260142408, CD_M20260142409; ~700 observations per match, polled roughly every 15 seconds through each match's full LIVE window

aggregate_counts_over_the_full_original_.home_players_away_players_distribution: 982 polls at home=5/away=5 (steady state); 7 polls at 0/0 (one first_observation row per match); 5 polls at home=4/away=5; 3 polls at home=5/away=6 -- every non-5/5 count self-corrected within one to a few polls

notes: The diagnostic module's player_appeared_*/player_disappeared_* flags are computed as an exact Champion Data playerId set difference between successive polls (collection.match_interchange_evidence._player_set_transitions, set(current) - set(previous)) -- their presence in this real captured data is direct proof, not an inference, that array membership genuinely changes during LIVE play.

This excerpt (and the original full report it was trimmed from) carries no individual Champion Data player IDs and no raw per-poll payloads -- scripts/report_interchange_evidence.py's human-readable mode prints only aggregate counts (home_players/away_players, home_total/away_total) and flag names, not entry-level detail. A specific player cannot be cited by ID as 'appeared, left, then came back' from this format alone; see afl_json/match_interchange.py module docstring for exactly what this evidence does and does not establish.

No POSTGAME/CONCLUDED status row is present anywhere in the original full report for any of the 7 matches -- every printed observation shows match_status_at_poll=LIVE (with one exception below). Whether array membership continues to change, freezes, or reflects a final settled bench once a match leaves LIVE therefore remains unverified.

CD_M20260142406 briefly recorded match_status_at_poll=CONFIRMED_TEAMS for several consecutive polls mid-match (seq 426-438) while interchange transitions continued firing normally -- a data-quality observation about local matches.status tracking, not evidence against the membership finding.

The handful of polls showing home_players/away_players other than 5 (see aggregate_counts_over_the_full_original_report) always self-corrected back to 5 within one to a few polls, consistent with catching an in-progress swap mid-transition at the 15s polling granularity, and inconsistent with a pool that is ever genuinely resized.

Used by afl_json/match_interchange.py's module docstring and docs/architecture/api/interchange_api_design.md §2.1 as the cited evidence basis for exposing on_bench as a confirmed-for-LIVE-play semantic (Issue #204, PR #206).
